extracted.intended_audience: UK-based researchers and research organisations seeking EPSRC / UKRI grant funding
extracted.subtask_description: A web listing of current EPSRC (UKRI) funding opportunities, showing opportunity summaries, funder/co-funder information, eligibility notes, award ranges, and key dates. Useful for prospective applicants to discover calls and check basic eligibility, budget expectations, and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for EPSRC funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is stated as a mandatory eligibility requirement for at least some opportunities (e.g., Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills). Applicants should verify their host organisation is on EPSRC-eligible lists before preparing an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation requirement (invite-only opportunities)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some calls (for example the 'UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment') are invite-only. Only invited applicants may submit; do not prepare or submit an application unless explicitly invited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award range / total fund expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Award range: £10,000,000 - £11,300,000 (example for Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills); Total fund: £3,000,000 (example for UKRI metascience call).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page reports expected award amounts and total funds available for each opportunity; applicants should align their proposed budgets to the stated award ranges and total programme funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full economic cost (FEC) and funding proportion
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls state whether funding is awarded at a percentage of FEC (e.g., 80% FEC). Applicants must prepare FEC-compliant budgets and understand the funder contribution proportion when calculating requested amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity status (open/closed)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listing indicates whether an opportunity is currently open. Applicants should only proceed if the opportunity is open and within the stated opening/closing window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key dates and times (publication, opening, closing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication date, Opening date (with time and timezone), Closing date (with time and timezone) are provided for each opportunity (e.g., Opening date: 6 May 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date: 7 July 2026 4:00pm UK time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadlines include precise times and timezone (UK time). Applicants must submit by the stated closing time and should note publication and opening dates for planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funders and co-funders / partner organisations
rubrics_metrics.description: Funders and co-funders are listed for each opportunity (e.g., Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC); co-funders such as Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT); multiple UKRI councils listed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The named funders/co-funders can affect scope, policy requirements, and eligible activities. Applicants should review funder/co-funder lists to identify any additional terms, priorities, or cross-council requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding type: Grant (as indicated for listed opportunities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each opportunity specifies the type of funding (grant, etc.). This determines allowable costs, contract terms, and application processes; applicants should prepare materials appropriate to a grant-funded award.
